checks.name: the project is named Sound, its main scene is chord.tscn, its renderer Compatibility
supplied/ holds its 15 files, none declares a class_name, and the project lists no named class: nothing needs an import
every script is indented with tabs: []
headless, Godot mixes with its Dummy driver at 44100 samples a second: nothing reaches a loudspeaker, and the mixer can still be read
one second of one tone of 256 Hz is 88200 bytes; its first four samples are [0, 1194, 2388, 3578], sample 43 is 32766, the loudest is 32766 of 32767
render() of the chord 3:2 writes 88200 bytes, each sample the two sines at half height times 32767, cut to a whole number: the first four are [0, 1493, 2983, 4466]
the loudest sample of 3:2 is 31226: the two tones never stand at their tops together
the voice's stream is an AudioStreamWAV: 16 bits, 44100 samples a second, one channel, 1.000 s long, holding those bytes
it loops forward from sample 0 to sample 44100
the voice is an AudioStreamPlayer3D on top of the box, unit_size 1, silent until a body comes

for 1:1, 2:1, 3:2 and 45:32 on 256 Hz the faster tone is 256, 512, 384 and 360 Hz, read back, and the loop closes: the step at the seam is no larger than a step inside. { "1:1": { "high_hz": 256.0, "loudest": 32766, "seam_step": 1194, "largest_step_inside": 1195 }, "2:1": { "high_hz": 512.0, "loudest": 28837, "seam_step": 1791, "largest_step_inside": 1792 }, "3:2": { "high_hz": 384.0, "loudest": 31226, "seam_step": 1493, "largest_step_inside": 1493 }, "45:32": { "high_hz": 360.0, "loudest": 32760, "seam_step": 1437, "largest_step_inside": 1437 } }
on 261.63 Hz, the piano's middle C, the second does not hold a whole number of turns: the step at the seam is 5114, the largest inside 1527. A click once a second
encode_s16(i * 2, wave) with the wave between -1 and 1: 88200 bytes and every sample is 0. Sample 43, where the wave is 0.999997, is 0
before anything plays the Master bus is at -200.0 dB: Godot's floor
played, the unscaled buffer is silence: playing is true, the position moves (0.10 s), the bus stays at -200.0 dB, and Godot logs no error and no warning in this run
with no loop the player stops by itself when the second is over: playing is false
the repaired buffer is heard: the bus reaches 0.0 dB, and the mix holds 256 Hz at 1.00 of full range and none of the other tones
the chord 3:2 through a plain player, looped: still playing after 1.3 s, the bus at -0.4 dB, the mix holds 256 Hz at 0.50 and 384 Hz at 0.50, and no 360 or 512

without the two halves the sum reaches 62452, past 32767; encode_s16() does not refuse it, it wraps: 17600 of 44100 samples read back as another number. The first is sample 12: 33888 was asked, -31648 is in the buffer
a tone of 43844 Hz, 256 short of the rate, gives the samples of 256 Hz upside down: the largest difference over the second is 0 of 32767. The buffer cannot tell the two apart
a tone of 22050 Hz, half the rate, is sampled where it crosses zero each time: every sample is 0

each of the four chords has one figure: a MultiMesh of 5512 boxes of 2 cm in LINE, with no collider; by the rule no bead leaves the square of 1 m, and each figure closes within the eighth of a second the beads cover
by the rule the beads fall in 50, 273, 464 and 2166 of the 2500 cells of a 50 by 50 grid over the square, for 1:1, 2:1, 3:2 and 45:32
ratio changed on a chord that already stands in the room is kept as a text and changes nothing: the faster tone is still 360 Hz. set() with a name the script does not have does nothing, in silence
chord.tscn runs 180 frames and Godot logs no error: []
in it Chord runs chord.gd at 3:2 and Neighbour is the guest at 2:1; each prints its line: Chord: 3:2, 256.0 and 384.0 Hz
the chord is a box in BODY with a collider, a ring in GHOST on the floor, an Area3D and the figure; the neighbour's box is SECOND
the walker starts 2.2 m in front of the Chord, looking through its Eyes; the two chords stand 1.2 m apart, so their rings of 0.8 m overlap
with the walker outside both reaches nothing plays: the bus is at -200.0 dB

by the keys: W held for 45 steps brings the walker to (-0.6, 0.0, 0.73) and the Chord sounds alone; D for 18 steps to (-0.03, 0.0, 0.73) and both sound; D for 22 more to (0.67, 0.0, 0.73) and the Neighbour sounds alone
walked back to its start it is outside both reaches and both are silent
the walker walks into the Chord's reach and arrives: Chord sounds, the Neighbour does not; the mix holds [256, 384] Hz, at -7.1 dB
C changes to the fixed camera, and the ears go with the eyes: the same chord is now -16.9 dB, was -7.1 dB
C again: back behind the walker's eyes
it walks between the two boxes and through both figures, which stop nothing, and arrives where the rings overlap: both sound, the mix holds [256, 384, 512] Hz, at -2.4 dB
walked at the Neighbour's box it is stopped, "blocked", 0.46 m from its middle; there only the Neighbour sounds: [256, 512] Hz, at -6.3 dB
it walks away and both are silent again: -200.0 dB
the whole walk, and Godot logged no error: []
in its first steps the reach is entered by two bodies, the floor's and the chord's own box, both a StaticBody3D: ["StaticBody3D", "StaticBody3D"]. The `if` keeps the chord silent for them
the marble dropped over the middle falls through the figure and rests on the box, at 0.50 m; a marble is not a walker, and the chord stays silent
dropped 0.35 m to the side, through the beads, it lies on the floor at 0.10 m: the figure stops nothing
with unit_size 1 the voice is heard at -3.4 dB from 1 m, -9.4 from 2 m and -15.3 from 4 m: each doubling takes about 6 dB
with the voice 2 m to the listener's left the left side is louder: -7.3 dB against -13.4 dB
with Godot's default unit_size of 10 the voice is as loud from 4 m as from 1 m, -0.4 and -0.4 dB: on a floor of 8 m distance would not be heard

the room task, done to a copy of the guest's script (5:4 on 192 Hz, and one line for a swell): it prints Sound: 5:4, 192.0 and 240.0 Hz, the loudest sample is 32271, the samples at 0 s and 0.5 s are 0 and 0, and the loop closes: the step at the seam is 0
a walker in its reach: the mix holds [192, 240] Hz, and over six short listenings the level went from -15.6 to -5.9 dB: it swells
